topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and mutation progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining learning outcomes, the multi-step mutation progression model, and the cancer hallmarks framework.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt signaling cascades drive autonomous cellular proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Blocks in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells arrest terminal differentiation in hematopoietic lineages and the intestinal epithelium to maintain an aberrant proliferative state.

topics.label: Apoptosis evasion, replicative immortality, and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the intrinsic tumor-suppressive barriers of programmed cell death, telomere shortening, and p53 stress responses, and how cancer cells bypass them to achieve replicative immortality.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine cellular metabolic reprogramming in tumors, including aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific metabolic profiles, and the role of oncometabolites in altering gene expression.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how developing tumors overcome oxygen and nutrient diffusion limits by activating the angiogenic switch to stimulate blood vessel growth.

topics.label: Metastasis and systemic dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyse the biological steps of the metastatic cascade, the seed-and-soil hypothesis governing metastatic inefficiency, and the genomic characteristics of disseminated metastases.

topics.label: Closing remarks and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of the hallmarks framework, recommended reading, and closing logistics.
